sources_quoted.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts).
sources_quoted.note: The only 'recast' language in math-foundations is the generic shared-timeline scheduler ('casts again when cooldown elapsed'). It defines no 'recast_of' relation and grants no license to call a stocked charge a recast.

independent_computation.question: Is the rotation slot 'Q2' in scenario syndra_derived_order_60 a RECAST of Q, or the second stocked CHARGE of Q gated at 40 Splinters of Wrath?
steps: 1. Enumerate Syndra's abilities from the cached wiki (data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities). Q = Dark Sphere, W = Force of Will, E = Scatter the Weak, R = Unleashed Power, P = Splinters of Wrath.

2. Search every ability's effect text for a recast clause. Exactly one hit: W, 'Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held' (plus W's Recast: effect and W notes 'If the ability is not recast within the duration...'). Q's text has NO recast clause anywhere.

3. Locate what Q gains instead: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' Corroborated by Q's rechargeRate = [7,7,7,7,7] and Q's notes describing sphere-charge pips under the health bar. That is a charge/ammo system (stock, max 2, periodic recharge), which is categorically different from a recast (a second activation of an ability that is currently in a held/recastable state).

4. Classify with the repo's own atom taxonomy. Enumerating all 185 atom_ids across data/wiki-atoms/*.json returns ZERO atoms whose id contains 'recast'. Syndra's Dark Sphere is named explicitly inside stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo: 'stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)'. So 'recast_of atom' names an atom that does not exist in the atom database; the correct atom is stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo.

5. Independently confirm the Q2 slot's meaning from the cached audit corpus (data/champion-audit): batch-6 lists notable atom 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)' and notes 'synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)' with 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge'; batch-e9-1 says '40+ Q charges via Q2 slot'. Both describe Q2 as an ammo/charge slot, never a recast.

6. Check the scenario's gate arithmetic. splinters = 60. P caps splinters at 120. Q's charge gate is 40: 60 >= 40 -> a second Dark Sphere charge is stocked, so the Q2 slot is live in the rotation. W's gate is 60: 60 >= 60 -> W true damage is also live. E's gate is 80: 60 < 80 -> not live. P's capstone is 120: 60 < 120 -> not live. The ONLY thing that puts Q2 into a splinters=60 rotation at all is the 40-splinter charge gate, so the source line for Q2 must cite that gate or it justifies nothing.
7. Compare the two candidate strings against steps 2-6.
independent_computation.correct_value: Q2 = second stocked Dark Sphere charge, gated at 40 splinters (Q Transcendent Bonus: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2'; stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo atom). Q has no recast; the recast in Syndra's kit is W, Force of Will.
independent_computation.old_value_assessment: Substantively correct and load-bearing. Its parenthetical '(40+ splinter second charge)' is a verbatim-checkable match to the Q Transcendent Bonus text and to the audit corpus's 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)', and it is exactly the gate that makes Q2 present at splinters=60. The bare edge label 'recast_of' reads as the rotation graph's parent-slot relation name (Q2's parent is Q), and the parenthetical immediately disambiguates it as a charge, not a wiki recast.
independent_computation.new_value_assessment: Fails on three independent counts. (a) FACTUALLY WRONG: 'Q2 is the recast of Q' contradicts the cached wiki — Q has no recast clause, W does; Q2 is a stocked charge. (b) CITES A NON-EXISTENT ATOM: '(recast_of atom)' — no atom_id in data/wiki-atoms contains 'recast'; the atom that names Syndra's Dark Sphere is stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo. (c) CIRCULAR AND EVIDENCE-DESTROYING: 'Q2 is the recast of Q - Q2 is Q's recast' restates the claim as its own justification and deletes the 40-splinter gate, i.e. it removes the only wiki-checkable content in the line and the only fact that explains why Q2 appears in a 60-splinter rotation. A source entry that sources nothing is not a source.

caveat: The ideal wording would drop 'recast_of' entirely and read as an ammo/charge citation (e.g. "Q2 = 2nd Dark Sphere charge, 40+ splinters, stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo"). Between the two values actually offered, the old one is the one that survives the cached-wiki check; the new one does not. Verdict is therefore old_value_correct, not both_wrong.
